session: Dev sessions (HS256 dev JWTs, fresh user ids) against the API in memory mode on 127.0.0.1:3187, reached through a local proxy on 127.0.0.1:3188 that logs every request, holds POST .../course/gpx-preview for 4 s on demand (to see the loader) and drops connections on demand (Offline). Launched with --deeplink crewcue://dev/app-shell --api-base-url http://127.0.0.1:3188 --dev-session <user> athlete <token>, which opens runner setup from the onboarding state. Course and past-run files (course-50k-with-aids.gpx, an edited copy with one XML comment, corrupt.gpx, activity-long-trail.gpx) were picked in the system file picker from Files > On My iPhone. OnboardingRunnerSetupFlowTests ran the signed-in flow on both simulators (TEST_RUNNER_CREWCUE_SETUP_* with SLOW_PREVIEW=1); the rest was driven by hand. Not re-run this round: the daylight saving message and the 429 course save limit (no code path changed; see the 2026-11-17 round in git history), Auth0 sign-up.
action: Chooser, I'm running a race; account step 'Your name' (empty, never the email); course step with Choose course file disabled until 'Race name' is typed; Back to the account step keeps the name, Continue keeps the race name. First file picked offline: the file is kept with the Offline copy and Try again; clearing the race name disables Try again (B3); online again, Try again creates the race named 'Tahoe Rim 2027' and shows the Cairn loader with 'Reading your course…' until the map and elevation profile draw; the race name is then read-only. Start time saved (PUT /course), history step first visit offers Import and Skip only. Back to the course: the same file picked again sends no request (M3); corrupt.gpx shows 'Couldn't save this step.' with Try again and Cancel, the saved course's map still there; Cancel keeps the saved course. Continue over the unchanged start sends nothing. History: activity-long-trail.gpx imported, 'Finish 10:59 AM instead of 11:20 AM', Continue, teaser 10:59 AM with Aid 1 to Aid 3 locked. Relaunch: teaser; Back to history shows Continue; Continue keeps 10:59 AM with no write request (B2). Back to the start time, zone changed to America/Los_Angeles, relaunch before Continue: the start time step reopens with the edit (M1); Continue sends only PATCH /race-rooms/:roomId/race-start, history's Continue keeps the estimate, which moved with the start (10:59 AM Pacific Time). Back to the course, the edited copy picked and saved (PUT /course), relaunch before history's Continue: the history step reopens instead of the teaser; Continue computes a new estimate (POST /pacing-estimates, PUT .../pacing-estimate). Teaser offline after a relaunch: Offline copy and Try again; online, Try again loads it. Sign out (no onboarding-setup.json or course file left on disk), sign back in as the same user: teaser in this phone's zone (7:00 AM start, 11:59 AM finish Mountain, the same instants); Back to history, Back to the start time filled from the race's raceStartAt (7:00 AM America/Denver), no Choose course file, Continue moves on; Back to the course shows 'Course saved' with course-50k-edited.gpx and Continue; no write request since signing in (B1). Dev route: Back on the signed-out account step of crewcue://dev/onboarding-runner-setup opens the app's own launch, the chooser (M6).
